title: Juniperus communis tincture for medicinal use
intro: Juniperus communis tincture is a concentrated herbal preparation made by soaking the berries of the common juniper plant in alcohol. This tincture is traditionally used in herbalism to support urinary tract health and promote diuresis. It is often employed to help alleviate symptoms of bladder infections and kidney stones. The preparation is also believed to have antimicrobial properties that can assist in cleansing the urinary system. Juniperus communis tincture is typically used under the guidance of a qualified herbalist or healthcare provider.
